description: GlobalBuildingMap — Unveiling the mystery of global buildings is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Xiao Xiang Zhu et al. Understanding how buildings are distributed globally helps describe the human footprint. This built environment affects local climate, land surface albedo, resource distribution, and many other key factors that influence well-being and human health. Despite this, quantitative data on the distribution and properties of buildings worldwide is lacking. Coverage: global; published in 2026. Formats: GeoTIFF, Raster. The data are held in Kaggle and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY, taken from the Data Records or Data Availability section of the paper. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
